shared_control_law: Before optimizing away structure, preserve semantic/causal/temporal/evidence identity, bound and repair recipient incompleteness, preserve observable causal uptake/effect closure, and measure observer/durability backaction plus recovery.
general_research_impacts: Evidence identity is multi-layer: semantic equality is not exact-current release evidence without byte/build/admission binding.
Historical reward equivalence targets measured causal function, not named-channel count.
Live fusion is adaptive and completeness-gated; targeted routing is one mode, not default truth.
Reentry keeps raw origin identity distinct from arrival/application and projection derivation; observer backaction is a promotion gate.
Causal receipt durability is semantic, but per-record fsync is not sacred; any batching optimization must beat strict durability under crash/power-loss-surrogate and effect-idempotency tests.
anti_echo: Distribution does not increase evidence class and does not create independent replication.
frank_boundary: Frank remains separate research subject; no self-Harness authority is granted.
